title: Have any of you guys seen the tv show The OA?
content: Very Mallworld-y vibes… I’d be curious to see if the creators have had the dreams too or if they intentionally used some real life stuff in the writing. Season 2 gets even deeper into the shared dream/dream collection themes. Some of their other work is also very in line with ideas I see come up in here a lot. Definitely worth a watch..
